description.text:
The deck that won the 10 and under division of the 2006 World Championships, named for Blastoise ex, Lugia ex and Steelix ex. Blastoise ex's Energy Rain gives the other two the Energy for attacks that can Knock Out most Pokémon in one hit. Decks of this kind took the division's first three places. The 2006 World Championships were held at the Hilton Anaheim in Anaheim, California, from 18 to 20 August 2006.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2006 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
